## Logger.console property

Get the underlying `console` object.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get console(): C;
```

## Remarks

Direct access to the console object is useful in tests, when the console is a mock object, which allows the logged messages to be checked. The type of the result is the type of the console that was passed to the constructor (`Console`<!-- -->, if none was passed), so the members of a mock object can be used without a cast.
